tasks.brief: Create src/services/models.py: Implement module-level constants NEMOTRON_BASE_URL, NEMOTRON_CHAT_ENDPOINT, NEMOTRON_READY_URL, NEMOTRON_SCRIPT_PATH, NEMOTRON_READY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, NEMOTRON_TERMINATE_GRACE_SECONDS. Track _nemotron_process (None when not loaded). Implement list_models() -> list[dict]: read LLM_ENDPOINT from os.environ, derive LM Studio base by stripping /chat/completions suffix, call httpx.get(base + '/v1/models'), on exception/non-2xx treat LM Studio portion as empty, append {'id': 'nemotron', 'source': 'nemotron'} iff is_nemotron_loaded() returns true. Implement is_nemotron_loaded() -> bool: return _nemotron_process is not None and poll() reports still-running. Implement load_nemotron() -> dict: idempotent if loaded; else spawn via subprocess.Popen(['python3', expanded_script_path]), store in _nemotron_process, poll NEMOTRON_READY_URL up to timeout; on success return {'status': 'loaded'}, on timeout terminate and return {'status': 'error', 'message': ...}. Implement unload_nemotron() -> dict: idempotent if not loaded; else terminate, wait up to grace seconds, escalate to kill(), clear _nemotron_process, return {'status': 'unloaded'}. Acceptance: test_list_models_includes_lmstudio_entries, test_list_models_degrades_when_lmstudio_unreachable, test_list_models_omits_nemotron_when_not_loaded.

Create src/api/models.py: Implement FastAPI router with GET /api/v1/models, POST /api/v1/nemotron/load, POST /api/v1/nemotron/unload. GET /api/v1/models: call models.list_models() and return ModelsListResponse. POST /api/v1/nemotron/load: call models.load_nemotron() and return NemotronLoadResponse. POST /api/v1/nemotron/unload: call models.unload_nemotron() and return NemotronUnloadResponse. Acceptance: test_load_nemotron_spawns_and_confirms_ready, test_load_nemotron_idempotent_when_already_loaded, test_load_nemotron_timeout_returns_503_and_terminates, test_unload_nemotron_terminates_process, test_unload_nemotron_idempotent_when_not_loaded.

Modify src/services/llm.py: Update stream_reply(message: str, history: Sequence[dict[str, str]] = (), endpoint_override: str | None = None) -> Iterator[StreamChunk]. When endpoint_override is not None, use it as upstream POST target; otherwise read LLM_ENDPOINT from os.environ. Message/history construction unchanged from M3/M4 (insert history between system prompt and user message). Streaming, failure classification, StreamChunk protocol unchanged. Acceptance: test_request_carries_model_user_message_and_stream_true, test_system_prompt_included_when_set, test_system_prompt_omitted_when_empty, test_content_chunks_yielded_as_tokens_in_order, test_clean_completion_yields_done, test_empty_stream_yields_error_not_done, test_config_read_at_call_time, test_connection_error_yields_error_with_no_tokens, test_non_2xx_yields_error_with_no_tokens, test_timeout_to_first_byte_yields_error, test_mid_stream_drop_yields_error_after_tokens, test_history_entries_in_upstream_messages, test_history_with_system_prompt_ordering, test_history_without_system_prompt_ordering, test_empty_history_matches_m3_behavior, test_multi_turn_history_preserves_all_entries, test_history_does_not_affect_streaming_behavior.

Modify src/api/chat.py: Add HistoryEntry pydantic model (role: Literal['user','assistant'], content: str). Update ChatRequest to include optional model field (str | None = None) and history field (list[HistoryEntry] = []). In POST /api/v1/chat handler: validate model type (if present must be string); if model == 'nemotron' and not models.is_nemotron_loaded(), return 422; resolve endpoint_override (NEMOTRON_CHAT_ENDPOINT if model == 'nemotron' else None); call stream_reply(message, history, endpoint_override). Acceptance: test_chat_opens_event_stream_200, test_chat_streams_token_events_in_order, test_chat_emits_done_after_tokens, test_chat_connection_error_emits_error_only, test_chat_mid_stream_failure_emits_error_after_tokens, test_chat_missing_message_is_422_no_stream, test_chat_with_history_streams_correctly, test_chat_history_passed_to_upstream, test_chat_history_defaults_to_empty, test_chat_invalid_history_role_is_422, test_chat_history_missing_fields_is_422, test_chat_history_missing_role_is_422, test_chat_empty_history_array_is_valid, test_chat_history_with_system_prompt_ordering, test_chat_routes_to_nemotron_when_selected, test_chat_routes_to_lmstudio_when_model_absent_or_other, test_chat_invalid_model_type_is_422, test_chat_nemotron_selected_but_not_loaded_is_422.

Modify src/static/index.html: Add model selector dropdown populated from GET /api/v1/models. Add Load/Unload Nemotron buttons that POST to /api/v1/nemotron/load and /api/v1/nemotron/unload respectively. On page load, fetch models and populate selector. When user selects model, include it in POST /api/v1/chat request body as 'model' field. Lock selector after first successful message send in conversation; unlock on page refresh. Acceptance: test_root_serves_html_page, test_page_wires_chat_endpoint.
